name: amp-token-monitor
description: Token usage monitor for the RxAi AMP agent memory system (read-only)

scripts.scan: npm run -s build && node dist/src/cli.js scan
scripts.report: npm run -s build && node dist/src/cli.js report
scripts.sessions: npm run -s build && node dist/src/cli.js sessions
scripts.backfill: npm run -s build && node dist/src/cli.js backfill
scripts.serve: npm run -s build && node dist/src/cli.js serve
